title: Answer: fundamental entities, humans and animals, perhaps the universe

statements.text: At least some fundamental entities are conscious, and humans and other animals are. A rock need not be, though its parts are. On cosmopsychism the universe is conscious. On Goff’s universalist option every spatially related group of objects determines a subject.

sources.quote: she needn't hold that a rock has mental properties (just that the rock's fundamental parts do)
for any group of material objects, the members of that group, being spatially related, determine a conscious subject
